notes.title: Update #8 - Demo Update 1.03
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/8197ff0b9a15ad70a741760973b24105171f5adc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Howdy [b]Miners![/b][/p][p]Have you always been, like us, tempted to just rip out your opponent's heart after winning a fight in an FPS game? If so, we've made your gory dream come true. No need to thank us! With the latest update, we've introduced the player’s ability to deal deathblows and smoothed out several aspects of the gameplay to deliver an even more exciting gaming experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Deathblows[/b][/h3][p]If stepping on zombies' skulls or ripping out of their skinny chests the still-beating hearts is your thing, you've come to the right game.[/p][p]From now on, when you weaken a Space Zombie sufficiently with kicks and bullets, it’ll be highlighted with a red outline and the words "Finish Off" will appear. Pressing the button you assigned to the interaction will perform a finishing move, where your character will crush the zombie's skull with a boot or rip out its heart. The poor little thing will even continue to beat for a moment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/ce314b386bb75c16c282fa09f65f10796e0b7bc4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ladder System[/b][/h3][p]This is one of the larger fixes, and while less noticeable, it should improve the overall gameplay experience. Your character will now only grab ladders upon actual contact with them, rather than from a distance. This should eliminate those frustrating moments when you started climbing when you didn't mean to. Problem solved.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/288789eb1c60aa012494919cab3ecdaa83d228d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Minor fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We've improved how the player holds onto climbable ropes. From now on, climbing should be faster and smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]We've slightly redesigned part of the ninth floor, to the right of where you descend the ropes in the elevator shaft.[/p][/*][*][p]We've added a bit more gore here and there—just to spice things up.[/p][/*][*][p]The cracked wall concealing the Glowing Ice lump that triggers the Challenge can now be broken with any weapon, not just a pickaxe. This should make things easier when you're not in the mood for physical exertion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]More is to come.[/p][p align="start"]Stay tuned![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Support us on Kickstarter:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelthunder/orestruck-space-miner?ref=coglhs"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelthunder/orestruck-space-miner?ref=coglhs[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Follow us on X (Twitter):[/b][/p][p][url="https://x.com/PxThunderGame"]https://x.com/PxThunderGame[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Follow us on Facebook:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/pixelthundergamestudio"]https://www.facebook.com/pixelthundergamestudio[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]Join our Discord:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/W27VZVaS"]https://discord.gg/W27VZVaS[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update #6 - Demo Update 1.02
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/5417178b9c7e3084f3a3e7d435ef832301e1934f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Howdy [b]Miners![/b]  [/p][p]To celebrate the approaching summer, we've a refreshed demo for you! It contains not only new and upgraded technical solutions, but also uses a heavily modified gameplay, which, as we believe, will make the game world richer and the overall gaming experience more fun and immersive.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hyper Time[/b][/h3][p]This is the biggest change you'll notice. From now on, as an employee of Space Mine Corp., you'll have access to cybernetic body modifications. The first one of these will be [b]Hyper Time[/b]. This inconspicuous chip will allow you to slow down time and give you those few invaluable seconds of advantage over opponents that require quick reflexes. It comes in handy in clashes with Space Zombies armed with blasters or machine guns, where you'll be able to beat them to a draw.[/p][p]It's worth knowing that with each killed enemy, the Hyper Time level recharges slightly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/73784f9103a2d2acc32b013cd5d40b1e7fff72a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Challenges[/b][/h3][p][b]Challenges [/b]are short secret levels where you have to defend yourself against the hordes of Space Zombies, using only specific weapons and in a limited time frame. By killing zombies there, you collect money that can be used later on to buy ammo or body modifications.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/7854e774235d9ba2caa9e4c7d13d959d44696bc5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Searchable Crates and Bodies[/b][/h3][p]This is another change that should not escape your notice. Every dead body you encounter and some crates can be searched by holding down the interaction button for a few seconds. The items you find are instantly monetized and converted into Zombcoins, a currency that you can use to buy ammunition and, later in the game, cybernetic body modifications. [/p][p]While the contents of individual crates do not change, the chance of their appearance is purely random, so when completing a level multiple times, you can collect different numbers of items, depending on your luck.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/601e606d052b5921ef88674d4ac427b3886b1b26.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gung-Ho-o-matic Vending Machines[/b][/h3][p]Don't be surprised if you find less ammunition placed on the levels than before. You can now use the Zombcoins you earned from selling found items to buy as much ammunition as you want. Keep in mind, however, that ammunition is not cheap, so shop wisely and keep an eye out for things that can be sold.[/p][p]Please note, however, that ammunition for special weapons such as the revolver or sawed-off shotgun is not available in any of the vending machines.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/df1bda13cde71ead0866d4031be41778ea4495cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Melee Combat[/b][/h3][p]Some of you have been worried about what would happen if you ran out of ammo for the basic shooting weapon, the Nail Gun. Heeding your feedback, we added a melee weapon that should be a perfect fit for any miner—the futuristic pickaxe. It'll not only be your last resort, but also the centerpiece of a series of pickaxe challenges, where it's the only weapon you're allowed to use.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/22326f25acf7fc3522c9e3ae21f81a07ecbd9ab0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]DirectX12, Lumen, and Nanite[/b][/h3][p]From a technological point of view, an important step for us was the transition to [b]DirectX12[/b]. This allowed us to fully utilize the strengths of Unreal Engine 5.5 such as [b]Lumen[/b] technology (a fully dynamic global illumination and reflections system) and [b]Nanite[/b] (a virtualized geometry system that allows rendering complex scenes without suffering performance loss).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/70f2fee4de28ed8ac3d9a06c51e5609d7a360b21.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]DLSS 4, Multi Frame Generation, and Overall Performance Boost[/b][/h3][p]We have also implemented the latest version of DLSS (4.0.2) for even better performance and smoother gaming experience. And if your video card allows it, you can enable Multi Frame Generation to significantly boost the number of FPS.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/52cb375e17a28ab3ce85b238ed19581d319d6044.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]More is to come. [/p][p]Stay tuned!  [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Support us on Kickstarter:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelthunder/orestruck-space-miner?ref=coglhs"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelthunder/orestruck-space-miner?ref=coglhs[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow us on X (Twitter):[/b][/p][p][url="https://x.com/PxThunderGame"]https://x.com/PxThunderGame[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Follow us on Facebook:[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/pixelthundergamestudio"]https://www.facebook.com/pixelthundergamestudio[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Join our Discord:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/W27VZVaS"]https://discord.gg/W27VZVaS[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update #5 - Demo Update 1.01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/6d77d703ffd88fc556feec49b1ee8867749f8e56.png[/img]

Howdy [b]Miners![/b]

Taking heed of your feedback, we’ve developed a set of improvements for the demo that we hope will positively impact your experience of the game.


[b]Waypoint system:[/b]

To make it easier for you to immerse yourself in the game’s world, we’ve implemented a waypoint system that will allow you to reach your destination quickly and efficiently. However, we’d like to point out that this system doesn’t contain any hints about secret rooms and pick-up items that you can find within the game’s levels, and therefore should not interfere with your exploration of Terra-3. In the full version of the game, it’ll be possible to opt out of this system in the Gameplay settings menu, and it’ll also be absent on the highest difficulty level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/8f059cf86b2c2b7562d0ab33f070e32c3ed4ae0f.jpg[/img]


[b]Overall brightness:[/b]

You brought to our attention that the training level was too dark, especially since the player didn't have a flashlight at the time. We found a remedy for this without losing the atmosphere of the place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/b8bdcbfef5528254727f2c73c7f3962db49f6a22.jpg[/img]


[b]Improved performance:[/b]

We took this fix opportunity to improve the optimization of the training level. You should now be able to enjoy faster and smoother gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/2bb1091d0793806d7a8f2a397d3e5730a3212895.jpg[/img]


Stay tuned!

This change not only guarantees enhanced visuals, but also [b]significantly improves the game's performance[/b]. Thanks to features like MegaLights, [b]the game's frame rate has doubled in some places[/b], even on Epic settings!

notes.title: Update #2 - Orestruck: Space Miner is coming to Kickstarter soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/7e5d1275864d4d5fbaf7f3005c195c54b32d61df.png[/img]

Howdy [b]Miners![/b]

[b]Orestruck: Space Miner[/b] is coming to Kickstarter soon!

Orestruck: Space Miner is our passion project, intended to revive what was best in the genre and be a spiritual successor to classic shooters that weren’t afraid to push the enemy-blood-soaked envelope, but it’s also a huge and complex undertaking for our modest team of four, with only three developers (being also three brothers) on board.

Why did we take on this enormous task? Because we love great games that serve up top-notch entertainment with no holds barred, which, unfortunately, we feel that have been glaringly lacking in recent years.]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433989/254760c787fc45be07bc75c9d8b6be8920bbfbe6.gif[/img]

First of all, [b]we don't intend to settle for half-measures[/b]. Our goal is not a short game, but a full-blown, multi-hour single-player campaign that will leave you with a lot of fun, a constant adrenaline rush, and a sweaty mouse pad.

In a word, even though we are a small team, we won’t rest until we provide you with a full-fledged product that you won’t be able to distinguish from games produced by large studios, [b]only that it’ll be better[/b]. And memorable.

And that's where you, the potential player, come in. In order to maintain creative independence and be able to offer you the level of quality that will make it hard for you to put the virtual shotgun down, we need your support.

Up until now, the game's development has been funded from our own pockets (and the campaign is about 50% ready), but if we are to fulfill our vision and deliver a product to the gaming community that is worth your attention, the time has come to bring in some outside help. [b]And that is you, Dear Reader.[/b]

So if you believe, like us, that high-quality games haven't gone out of fashion and are still possible, grab your pickaxe, Miner, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixelthunder/orestruck-space-miner?ref=coglhs]go to our Kickstarter page and click that "Notify me on launch" button[/url] and get ready, because these zombies ain't gonna kill themselves!

We plan to launch our campaign on [b]February 24, 2025.[/b]
